value.rationale: The exact ordered fiber distribution is the natural finer invariant of the multiplication map from idempotent-nilpotent pairs to matrices, beyond merely describing its image. It completely distinguishes radical rank and primitive trace/determinant cases, exposes singleton fibers of nilpotent determinant-nonzero matrices, and establishes a closed q-parametric formula for all finite fields and both factor orders. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite table.
